notes.title: Great Experience On Steam Deck (unofficial)
notes.content: Although the game has not yet been reviewed by Valve on Steam Deck, it is checked according to a specific set of standards. But it has already been tested by developers on Steam Deck, and the result is Great Experience On Steam Deck.
